items.headline: $VAR Token Confirmed: 32% Airdrop in Q4 Launch
items.summary: Variational sets its Q4 $VAR token launch with a hefty 32% airdrop allocation. Points keep flowing at 150K per week while team and investor tokens sit under a 12-month lock.

items.headline: $ATOM Chaos: Neutron Exploit Halts Cosmos Hub 25hrs
items.summary: Cosmos Hub stopped producing blocks for nearly 25 hours after an attacker bought voting power for 20,199 USDC and staked it minutes before a Neutron proposal closed. 1.23M $ATOM moved from the attacker wallet.

items.headline: $ZEC Clears $1,600 on New 21Shares European ETP
items.summary: $ZEC broke above $1,600 as 21Shares launched a physically backed ETP in Paris and Amsterdam. Shielded supply now sits at 29% of all ZEC.

items.headline: $USDV Debuts: Solomon Labs Launches on Solana
items.summary: Solomon Labs just launched its $USDV stablecoin on Solana, expanding the ecosystem with a fresh DeFi dollar play. Early-stage launch worth watching.

items.headline: $PENDLE Ships PT Looping for One-Click Yield Plays
items.summary: Pendle launched PT Looping, streamlining leveraged yield transactions into a single flow. A slick new DeFi use case for $PENDLE's yield-trading machine.
